identity.name: Elegance Collection
identity.one_liner: A small manual-wind dress watch with a cream dial and box-shaped sapphire crystal, discontinued and replaced by the near-identical SBGW301.

narrative.story: The SBGW231 is a compact manual-wind dress watch built on caliber 9S64, with a 72-hour power reserve and a cream dial under a box-shaped, AR-coated sapphire crystal. At 37.3mm it sits closer to mid-century dress-watch proportions than most of Grand Seiko's current catalog. Grand Seiko discontinued the reference and replaced it with the near-identical SBGW301.
narrative.collector_notes: Now discontinued, so buyers are working from remaining retailer stock or the secondary market; the successor SBGW301 carries essentially the same case and movement, so comparing the two before buying is worthwhile.
